edges: Klas August Linderfelt was the first librarian of the Milwaukee Public Library.
Klas August Linderfelt was especially close to William Frederick Poole.
Klas August Linderfelt succeeded Samuel Swett Green as President of the American Library Association.
The investigation into Klas August Linderfelt's embezzlement was prompted by the embezzlement of A.H. Schattenberg.
Klas August Linderfelt was arrested following a meeting with Mayor Peter J. Somers.
Klas August Linderfelt is the father of Karl E. Linderfelt.
Wayne A. Wiegand wrote about Klas August Linderfelt in a two-part article published in 1977.
Klas August Linderfelt was inducted into the Wisconsin Library Hall of Fame.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Karl E. Linderfelt was one of the commanders at the Ludlow Massacre.
